task_description: Write a method in Dafny to filter odd numbers.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method FilterOddNumbers(arr: array<int>) returns (odds: array<int>)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - All elements in the output array are odd
- Every odd element in the input array appears in the output array
- The order of odd elements in the output array corresponds to their order in the input array
